subject: Re: ENAS-LM status: GPU path reproduced, TPU slice slipped
body:
All,

Decisions ahead of window close, and with Q3 OKRs locking on the 26th I want these in writing.

1. TPU numbers came in June 8 at 56.2 perplexity - close enough to the published 56.1 +/- 0.1 to call reproduction done on both paths. Nice work.

2. Scope cut: the service API ships as batch-only for v1. Interactive search needs guaranteed Cirrus capacity we don't have this quarter; Paloma's API design keeps the door open.

3. The DARTS comparison goes in the writeup as-is (our cells within 0.4 perplexity at comparable params). That's enough for the internal audience; no extra sweeps.

Q3 OKR submission: two partner teams running searches through the batch service by end of Q3. Daniela, flag any staffing implication before Friday's lock, otherwise I'm submitting as-is.

Anders
